definition: an event of great suffering, or a serious drama with an unhappy ending
hook: Every tragedy you name traces back, somehow, to a goat.
modernAnchor: A tragedy is the worst kind of news to us. A disaster, a loss, a serious play that ends in ruin.
journey: The Greek word tragoidia splits into tragos, meaning goat, and oide, meaning song.
In the earliest Athenian festivals, choruses of singers competed in honor of the god Dionysus.
Scholars think a goat was the prize for the best song, or the animal sacrificed at the ritual itself.
Either way, the solemn dramas that grew out of those contests kept the name: the goat song.
